desc:
Shopify page speed check and fixes begins with testing your key pages on phone and desktop and ends with measured improvements. Ecom Swift LLC finds what slows your store, such as heavy images and extra apps, fixes the safe items and tests again.

## What is a Shopify page speed check?

A Shopify page speed check is a test of how quickly your pages load and respond, followed by a plain explanation of the causes. We test the home page, a collection page and a product page, since those are the pages most visitors see first.

The result is a ranked list of what holds each page back, with a note on how hard each fix is. For the larger packages, we carry out the fixes and compare the numbers before and after.

## Why slow pages cost you visitors

Shoppers rarely wait. On a phone, a page that takes too long to show its first image or to respond to a tap feels broken, and people go back to the search results. The loss happens before the shopper has seen a single product.

Speed problems also tend to build slowly. A large banner here, a new app there, a custom font, a video on the home page. No single choice looks harmful, but together they weigh down every page.

## How faster pages help your store

A page that loads quickly lets the shopper see products, scroll and tap without frustration. That keeps more people in the buying flow. Faster pages also make a better impression of the business, which supports trust.

Search engines look at page experience as one of many signals, so a quicker store can help you be found, though many other factors matter as well. We do not promise a particular score, because tools measure differently and results change from day to day. We focus on real, checked improvements to the things we can control.

## What a good speed check covers

- Tests on phone and desktop for the home, collection and product pages.
- A list of the largest images and how much they weigh.
- A review of which apps add scripts to the storefront.
- Compression and resizing of oversized images.
- Lazy loading, so images below the fold load later.
- A check of font choices and how many font files load.
- A review of sliders, carousels and autoplay videos.
- Removal of unused theme code and sections.
- Before and after numbers recorded in the same way.
- A final report that explains each change in simple words.

## What we do

We record the starting numbers first, so every later change can be measured against them. We then trace the biggest causes: images, apps, fonts, sliders and theme code.

Where code is involved, we work on a copy of your theme and keep your live store untouched until the result has been checked. We compress and resize images, delay or trim apps you agree to change, tidy the font settings, and remove sections and snippets nothing uses. Then we test again and show you the comparison. The Basic package delivers the report and the ranked fix list. Standard fixes the main issues and compares the results. Premium goes deeper into theme code, media and sliders, and ends with a full report.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Upload images at the size they will be shown, not at camera size.
- Keep the home page short, with only the sections you need.
- Ask whether an app is needed before you add it.
- Test speed on a real phone with a normal connection.
- Recheck after you add large banners or new apps.

**Avoid:**
- Autoplay videos at the top of the home page.
- Several sliders on one page.
- Loading many font families and weights.
- Judging speed from one test run.
- Removing apps without a plan for the features they supply.

## Who this is for

This service suits owners whose store feels slow on a phone, and sellers who see visitors leave quickly. It also suits stores that added many apps over the years, and anyone about to start paid traffic who wants the pages ready for it.

## What we need from you

We need a collaborator or staff invitation to your store, the addresses of the pages you care most about and a note on any apps or features you must keep. We never need your password. Speed is not a one-off job, because new images and apps add weight over time, so a recheck now and then is sensible. After you order, we send a short checklist and the first report.
